The '''Lubang Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lubang Minor]] and its two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].
